value_inflection_events.event: Positive G100 + pembrolizumab Phase 1/2 combination data for follicular lymphoma at ASCO 2017
CMB305 + checkpoint inhibitor data at ESMO 2017 showing greater clinical benefit and immune response
Pricing of $80 million public offering at ~$5.50 per share
Continued post-offering selling and dilution absorption
Discontinuation of Phase 3 SYNOVATE CMB305 trial and workforce reduction
ASH 2018 data: increased ORR and longer PFS with G100 + pembrolizumab in follicular lymphoma
Merck/Immune Design merger announcement at $5.85 per share cash

leaked_early.details: No pre-deal rumors or leaks detected.

notes: Deal followed the discontinuation of lead program CMB305, which collapsed the stock price; Merck capitalized on the depressed valuation to acquire the G100 program and platform assets at a 312% premium.
